payload.title: Savvy Games Group to acquire Moonton Games for $6 billion
payload.content: Savvy Games Group has agreed to acquire Moonton Games for $6 billion. TikTok maker ByteDance had originally paid $4 billion for Moonton in 2021. Moonton is the developer behind Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, one of the most popular mobile games in Southeast Asia. The deal represents a significant capital movement in the mobile gaming space, with the Saudi-backed Savvy Games Group continuing its aggressive expansion into the gaming industry.
